title: With -P 0 the client logs in with no patch connection and no patch error
notes: The launcher starts the client with -P 0, as it always does. The run folder first gets a copy of the install's
own Bin/PatchConfig.xml with only its patch host and port changed, to 127.0.0.2 and 12700, the place a
client that patches would connect to, and a local listener waits there; a second listener holds 12500, the
port the roadmap's check names. Neither may see a connection, and the guard ends the client the moment it
reaches anything off this machine. 127.0.0.2 is used because the client replaces 127.0.0.1 with this
machine's own address before it connects.
The client connects to the login port only when it is asked to log in, so the run logs in and waits for
the login server to admit it, which is the connection to the login port that -P 0 must leave working.
No patch failure and no patcher start may show in the client's log, and the login window is photographed.
No game server runs here, so the login server's two warnings about empty creation and realm tables are expected.

listeners.name: the patch port the roadmap names

server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
